note: Bang chung DAN DEN QUYET DINH cua bao cao gh-aw. Moi muc o day phai co mot permalink ghim SHA trong `docs/phat-trien/van-hanh/gh-aw-evaluation-v0.md`, va `anchor` phai con nam dung tai `line` trong ban clone gh-aw tai SHA da ghim. Sai mot trong hai dieu do thi phep dan xuat hoac bai kiem se do — bao cao khong the lang le mat bang chung, va bang chung khong the lang le troi khoi upstream.

claims.says: `EngineDefinition.Auth` nhan mot TEN BI MAT bat ky, khong co danh sach trang.
Ten bi mat tu `auth[]` di vao danh sach bi mat bat buoc cua engine.
Trinh bien dich tiem thang `<TEN>: ${{ secrets.<TEN> }}` vao env cua buoc chay tac nhan.
Bo loc bi mat giu lai dung nhung ten do `auth[]` khai — nen token OAuth khong bi cat.
Mot tep dung chung co khoi `behaviors` duoc nhan la DINH NGHIA ENGINE, khong phai loi cau hinh.
Bo loc chan moi tham chieu `${{ secrets.* }}` khong nam trong danh sach cho phep.

claims.anchor: strict mode: secrets detected in 'engine.env' section are excluded from the agent sandbox
claims.says: Duong thu hai — tiem bi mat qua `engine.env` cua engine dung san — bi tu choi luc bien dich.
Engine `claude` DUNG SAN lay ten bi mat tu nha cung cap, khong tu cau hinh nguoi dung.
Voi nha cung cap Anthropic, ten bi mat duy nhat cua engine dung san la `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
gh-aw cai CLI npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` ghim phien ban, khong goi action cua Anthropic.
Dieu kien chay cua job `safe_outputs` doc ket qua job `agent` — ten job ghim cung trong ma.
Quyen duoc tinh LUC BIEN DICH tu loai safe output, roi nuong vao `.lock.yml`.
`add-comment` cap CA `issues: write` lan `pull-requests: write`; `config.Target` khong duoc doc.

claims.anchor: Status comments for issue and pull request related events use issue comment endpoints.
claims.says: Cung mot SHA, nhanh activation lai chi cap `issues: write` — gh-aw tu mau thuan voi chinh no.
Mau thuan tren duoc KHOA bang mot bai kiem assert su VANG MAT cua `pull-requests: write`.
Luat xac thuc den tu bien moi truong, khong nam trong ma nguon.
Thieu cau hinh thi moi item thanh 'loai la' va duoc cho qua NGUYEN VEN — fail-open.
Dang comment khong tra cuu truoc, khong khoa idempotency — ngu nghia at-least-once.
Mot handler hong thi vong lap ghi log roi CHAY TIEP — khong rollback, khong hoa giai.
Job dac quyen checkout va giu lai thong tin xac thuc day duoc len repo.
Co ham ghim ref tin cay nhung khong noi nao goi — nen checkout dac quyen giai ra ref cua su kien.

claims.anchor: The agent job must not have write permissions.
claims.says: Ranh gioi khong-tin-cay duoc cuong che bang TU CHOI BIEN DICH — diem gh-aw manh hon Nexagent.
